self.g.objects(team_uri, agentoscin:hasTerminationCondition) and the nested self.g.objects(term_uri, agentoscin:hasSubCondition) each become their own single-motif m{ }: the outer loop's body dispatches on the term's type (an elif chain over four disjoint classes), which is exactly the case prior batches flagged -- joining a type triple into the same m{ } as the traversal would require ALL branches' types at once, so each `(x, RDF.type, C) in self.g` stays a separate bool(m{ {x} a C }).

repair.driver: after the unchanged module-state run, re-executes both artefacts on 5 case graphs (only the context line `self = ReaderSelf(g)` is substituted; team_uri stays a URIRef as in the repository) and compares max_turns, termination_conditions and stdout: a second team with its own conditions and Composite sub-conditions, TurnLimit without maxTurns and with a non-integer maxTurns, EventBased without trigger (top level and sub-condition), Composite without operator, unknown-type conditions that carry maxTurns/trigger and name every class of the elif chain through a neighbour predicate, neighbour predicates off the team and off the Composite, promotion of the first sub TurnLimit only, empty Composite, team with no condition, empty graph.

optimization_notes: optimized.py: the black-style folding of the region (each `(s, RDF.type, C) in self.g` tuple over five lines, each call over three) is undone, and the one-use temporaries trigger (twice) and operator are written into the dicts they fill; the composite dict is still appended after its sub-condition loop, so a raise in _int_value (OverflowError on an infinite maxTurns, which the shim does not catch) leaves termination_conditions as the original leaves it. The elif chains, the `mt is not None` guards and the promotion of the first sub TurnLimit are unchanged. The care ratio stays near 1 because the inline graph-building harness, copied as is, outweighs the region.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: the two traversals become `m{ {team_uri} agentoscin:hasTerminationCondition ?term_uri }` and `m{ {term_uri} agentoscin:hasSubCondition ?sub_uri }` under `@graph self.g`, the six type tests become bare `m{ {x} a agentoscin:C }` in their if/elif (no bool(): an if test), and the _int_value/_str_value predicates become prefixed names.
No exception to the symmetry; no join (the type dispatch is an elif chain over disjoint classes).
